findings.title: Context Lost in Queue-Miss Fallback Path
findings.description: present_native_frame_internal receives lifecycle_context parameter but does not pass it to decode_native_video_layers in the queue-miss fallback branch. Instead, it calls decode_native_video_layers(..., RenderLifecycleContext::empty()), breaking the propagation chain for explicit paused/scrub demands and any other queue-miss scenarios.
findings.evidence: Line 2857: decode_native_video_layers(&legacy_request, None, RenderLifecycleContext::empty()).await? should pass the received lifecycle_context parameter instead.
findings.consequence: Request identities are lost for all frames that miss the lookahead queue. Lifecycle registry cannot correlate these frames to their originating requests.
findings.fix: Change RenderLifecycleContext::empty() to lifecycle_context on line 2857. Remove underscore prefix from _lifecycle_context parameter name on line 2668.

findings.title: Test Does Not Exercise Async Pipeline
findings.description: The overlapping_requests_with_same_external_id_remain_independent test is a synchronous unit test that only validates registry mechanics by directly calling submit() and finish_request(). It does not invoke render_one(), decode_native_video_layers(), queue operations, or present_native_frame_internal().
findings.evidence: Test is marked #[test] not #[tokio::test], contains no .await calls, and never exercises async decoder dispatch, queue insertion/extraction, or presentation handoff.
findings.consequence: Violates task acceptance requirement: 'the overlapping-request test must exercise the actual asynchronous pipeline, not simply prove that two registry entries have different IDs.' No evidence that contexts survive async boundaries.
findings.fix: Convert to async integration test that submits overlapping demands, calls render_one() or equivalent async path, and verifies distinct internal IDs are preserved through decode → queue → present.
